append_repr_html_when_present: append rich HTML representations of objects that have a _repr_html_ method
create_contextual_value: create a contextual value to track whether repr_html is already being processed
build_foldable_tree_node: build a custom foldable tree node with a comment-colored label for rich HTML representation
embed_html_in_iframe: embed computed HTML representation in an iframe with a text-mode fallback
defer_html_rendering: defer HTML rendering with a placeholder while the rich representation is computed
